draft.reply:
Thanks for flagging this — yes, this is a known issue on our end (not something specific to your account). When a task has more than one assignee, CSV export can sometimes omit the "Assignee" column entirely, which matches what you're seeing. A fix is planned for an upcoming release.

In the meantime, the recommended workaround is to use JSON export instead, which correctly includes all assignees for multi-assignee tasks.

Sorry for the inconvenience — let us know if you run into anything else!
